display.title: Lane: Exploration
display.subtitle: Discover your way up
description: The Exploration lane rewards going places and finding things - and it
needs no Submit button. Tokens mint §aAUTOMATICALLY§r as you play:
- Slay minibosses and bosses (a named boss's FIRST kill pays a
one-time bonus; repeat kills still pay).
- Step into a new non-overworld dimension (a one-time bonus each).
- Loot tokens hide in chests, barrels, and the occasional enemy -
denser inside structures and other dimensions.
Exploration is always farmable, so the threshold is always reachable.
§7Follow the §6Exploration§7 group for the frontier checklist.
